description: A Rust workspace that publishes nothing to crates.io and ships a built artifact, such as a game mod. Same rules as rust-crates. The difference is what the repository adds, such as a submodule pointer or a crate it consumes from crates.io.
A toolchain bump is a fix here too, by rust-crates' rule: the toolchain builds the artifact this repository ships, and the standard library links into that binary.
